englishOnly: This tool works on English text. Paste your duties in English and it writes the bullets in English.
label: Paste the duties from your job description
hint: One duty per line. Bullet points, numbered lists and semicolons work too. Up to {max} duties.
private: Runs entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded or stored.
heading: {count, plural, one {Your duty as a bullet} other {Your # duties as bullets}}
intro: Each one opens with an action verb and marks where a number belongs. The highlighted slots are yours to fill. This tool does not know your numbers, so use figures you can defend in an interview.
toastFailed: Copy failed. Select the text and copy it yourself.

notes.ownership: Add the size of it: people in the team, the budget, or how many projects ran at once.
notes.support: Add how many a week, how fast you answered, or a satisfaction score.
notes.delivery: Add how long it took, how many people use it, or what changed after launch.
notes.process: Add hours saved, errors removed, cost cut, or how many records it covered.
notes.analysis: Add how much data, which decision it fed, or the change it led to.
notes.general: Add how many, how often, how much, or how much faster.

ctaTitle: Applying for a new job with these?
ctaBody: Paste the job link and FitMyCV rewrites every bullet against that posting, keeping your real experience and your real numbers.
ctaButton: Tailor these to a new job

perDuty.title: One bullet per duty
perDuty.body: Weak openers like 'Responsible for' removed, and a past tense action verb up front.

slot.title: A slot for your number
slot.body: Each bullet marks where a figure belongs, so it reads as a result.

number.title: Which number to find
number.body: A note under each bullet on what to count: people, hours, money or change.
